instruction.text: By the 1800s, most people in England were Protestant. Select the man in the top hat to find out more.

feedback.finish: Most Victorians were very religious people. They feared God, went to Church often and followed the Bible.

instruction.text: The Victorian era was also a time of invention and discovery. Match each invention to the correct name.

atoms.b: The ((++Bible poem)) teaches Christians about how the world began, and it says that Earth is about 6,000 years old.
However, Victorian scientists began discovering ((++rocks books)) and fossils that were millions of years old.
This upset Victorians because it showed that plants and ((++animals electricity)) lived long before the Bible said that Earth was created.

instruction.text: This is a fish fossil, discovered to be millions of years old. Answer the questions.

atoms.a: Does this agree with the Bible?
How do you think Victorian Christians felt about this discovery?

feedback.finish: Many Victorians thought that science was an insult to God because it made people question whether the Bible was entirely true.

instruction.text: This is Charles Darwin, a Victorian scientist. Listen to his theory of evolution and answer the questions.

hint.text: Evolution is the process of living things gradually changing over many, many years.
hint.label: Evolution

atoms.sound: <voice voiceLang='en' voice='m8'>Humans evolved from apes over thousands of years.</voice> Does this agree with the Bible?

atoms.a: How do you think Victorian Christians felt about his idea?

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps in this conversation between two Victorians.

atoms.b: Everyone knows that humans were made by ((++God apes)). It says so in the Bible!
Charles Darwin and his ((++believers animals)) will go straight to hell for spreading these lies!
I’m a Christian too, but Darwin’s evidence is very ((++strong string)). Maybe God designed or created evolution?
That’s not what the Bible says at all! We were made as ((++humans person)) in God’s image.
I think that both the Bible and science can be ((++correct fun)). Maybe the Bible’s story just isn’t exactly how it happened.

feedback.finish: Many Christians today don’t think that the Bible tells the creation story exactly. They believe that God made the world, and that science then explains how God’s creation works.
